stable.notes: The ledger bar now hugs the character. 0.5.144 reserved the tallest pose's height for every pose, and with the stock idle at 3x that left a 1x combat figure under roughly two figure-heights of empty space — the bar floated up to ~700px above the character's head. The panel keeps its stable width so a poll never re-centers the pet, but its height now tracks the current pose: the bar, caption, hover pills, title card, and lists sit directly above the figure in every state, and the figure itself never moves. Everything else in 0.5.144 — the ledger vocabulary, completion chips, terminal jump, Miles Windu V15.3, character speed — is unchanged. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
